decisions.machine_status: The machine will be serviced before use.

commitments.detail: The machine will be serviced and the worn foot pedal will be replaced with a new FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant.
Jordan will complete 3 garments using cotton material, and Rosa will use the pedal method for her project.
Jordan's project is scheduled to be ready by September 1, 2026.
The adjustable sewing table in Maya's craft room will be set up at a height of 75 cm, and Rosa will use the seated position.
